title: Dense-pairing floors for overcomplete root-code decoders (E6 36, D5 20, every m) and for every rank-T realisation (E8 72, E7 49, D6 30, D4 12, P104 56), with a correction to Conjecture ID (a) (no κ claim)
head: ca7f99921f03398d303bba90245d3ee2e38e95c3
body:
## Dense-pairing floors for overcomplete root-code decoders (E6 36, D5 20, every m) and for every rank-T realisation (E8 72, E7 49, D6 30, D4 12, P104 56), with a correction to Conjecture ID (a) (no κ claim)

Package `research/overcomplete-and-realisation-floors`. Model, cost formula and the dense pairing are those of #446, #595/#1590, #2111/#2125 and #2228 (root-code floors, where **Conjecture ID** was stated). Credit for the E8 / P112 / P104 floors and the overcomplete structure: #968, #1077, #1180, #1212, #1224 (joaqcoo), #1633 (bbMisk), #1815, #1236, #1744; independent exact E6 screens: #2137, #2232, #2240, #2247 (1337isnot1337). The free-term mechanism is the "free rectangle" of #1331 (Arham-Tahir64) and #1375 (commdata2338), see also #1460 (bbMisk), #1468 (bitplane), #1591 (Arham-Tahir64), scoped P112 results; Proposition 3.1 is the same move applied to whole units, and what is new here is its use against Conjecture ID (a). The Shadow Lemma is Lemma CR2 of #2162, with a rectangular Lean form in #2267. No κ claim, no window closed, no supplier changed.

**Correction to our own Conjecture ID (#2228 §6, branch (a)).** For an odd geometry the conjecture says the optimal cost is `v`. With an unbounded number of terms this is false: the 120-line unit with all pairs orthogonal and `M = I` has an exact decoder of cost **72 < 120** (8 E8 coordinate terms of rank 9 plus 6,720 free single-entry terms, `B = J + Ā_E8`; **PROVEN + CHECKED**, exact over 6,728 terms). Proposition 3.2 gives the repaired reading `cost*(U) = min over admissible B of c(B)`. F_120 (and F_104) are degenerate (`T = v`); no counterexample to (a) with `T < v` is known. The Conjecture ID values for the nine even root units, #2228 Theorem 1 and Corollary 2.2 are not affected; the theorems below assume `col P ⊆ col M`, where free single-entry terms are not available.

**Results (each with its scope in README §2).**
- **Lemma OC** (**PROVEN**; algebraic core in Lean, no `sorry`): for `Σ_{j≤m} x_j y_jᵀ = id_T` the cross matrix `K = (⟨y_i, x_j⟩)` is an idempotent of rank `T`; `m = T` gives biorthogonality, `m = T+1` gives a rank-one off-diagonal part; a criterion (diagonal plus rank one) for prescribed directions. It is the basis-free form of the `ABᵀ = 2I` identity of #1224.
- **E6 ≥ 36 and D5 ≥ 20 for every `m`** (**PROVEN** from **CHECKED** data), for root-code decoders (factors in `col M`, realisations `D₁ G D₂`), dense `B`, characteristic 0. The open E6 case `m = 7` (seven rank-5 terms) is closed by an exhaustive exact-integer search over **5,504,660** seven-sets with a rank-one cross matrix: none has spanning row and column directions. `m = 6` is the coupling argument and `m ≥ 8` is trivial. This is the whole root-code class, not a finite alphabet; it agrees with the minima 40 / 37 of #2240 / #2247.
- **Theorem 4′ and a frame-intersection certificate** (**PROVEN**): the root-code floor holds for **every realisation of rank `T`**; relative to #2228 Theorem 4 (arbitrary `N` but factors in a scaled root code) this adds the case `col M ≠ D₁·root code`: E8 ≥ 72, E7 ≥ 49, D6 ≥ 30, D4 ≥ 12, P104 ≥ 56, P112 ≥ 56 for every decoder with `col P ⊆ col M`, `col Q ⊆ row M` (all square decoders, any `m` otherwise), dense `B`. The first five are attained (**CHECKED**), so they are sharp; for P112 the realisation-free bound is 56 against 64 attained (OPEN).
- **Arbitrary pairings, SAT with DRAT** (kissat 4.0.4; every UNSAT proof DRAT-verified by `drat-trim` at generation, 44 of 46 primary proofs shipped and re-checked by `verify.sh`; for the E6 `Γ` and shared-B parts `verify.sh` checks CNF hashes and recorded verdicts, labelled RECORDED in the README; every SAT model checked clause by clause): the smallest rank of an admissible `B` on the 36 E6 lines is **7**; F2 shadow minranks `mr₂(Γ_E6) ≥ 7`, `mr₂(Γ_E7) ≥ 8`, so a `B`-independent F2 shadow cannot certify E6 or E7 with `T` terms; per-term drops are real (an E6 pair of dense rank 6 has fitting minrank 4), but a shared `B` brings none of **26** E6 square decoders below 36 (**1,262** cap-vector instances, all UNSAT); the known optimal decoders (E8, E7, P112, P104) have fitting minrank equal to dense rank on every term checked.

**Scope and caveats (as in the README).** Floors are for the dense pairing, for `col P ⊆ col M`, `col Q ⊆ row M`, characteristic 0, and (Theorem 4′) realisations of rank exactly `T`. Not covered: arbitrary `B` for a whole unit (only the SAT statements above, with the scopes given), factors outside `col M` (the 9-term decoder of #1180; see also #1224, #1633), realisations of rank above `T`, E6 / D5 realisation-free (no `T`-frame), P112 ≥ 64 for every realisation, `T = 3`. The SAT statements are about the listed units, terms and 26 decoders, not about all decoders. The two E6 `Γ` DRAT proofs (about 90 MB each) and the 1,418 shared-B proofs (about 600 MB) are not shipped; the generator regenerates every CNF (hashes checked) and all were solved and DRAT-verified by the author. The Lean file proves the idempotency, trace and square-case parts of Lemma OC; the rank statements and consequences are written proofs.

**Verify.** `bash research/overcomplete-and-realisation-floors/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (Python standard library only, single process; step 0 checks `MANIFEST.sha256` and `SOURCES.json` and stops hard on mismatch; 57 PASS lines including step 0's two, among them `c6.decoders`, the exactness of the 26 E6 decoders, about 2.5 minutes on one core). `DRAT_TRIM=/path/to/drat-trim` additionally re-checks the 44 shipped DRAT proofs (otherwise one SKIP line). Overlap check against open and merged PRs (#1224, #1633, #1815, #2137, #2232, #2240, #2247, #2228 read in full or in part) in the PR discussion; the helper `scripts/find_overlap.py --refresh` was also run (it surfaced discussion 1316, the free-rectangle line of #1331, and nothing else uncited).
